components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact coral action used for the message send control and other singular actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--sylph-coral, oklch(0.73 0.13 38)); color: #201d19; font: 500 13px/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #f4af98; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.75 0.11 37); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.75 0.11 37 / 50%); outline: none; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet utility action that appears through a shallow field on interaction.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); font: 500 13px/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 5%); color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.75 0.11 37 / 50%); outline: none; }

components.name: Active Workspace
components.description: Nested Workspace row with a shallow field, coral edge, live status, branch, and change summary.
components.css: .ds-workspace { position: relative; display: grid; width: 268px; grid-template-columns: 12px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 6.5%); color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77); text-align: left; } .ds-workspace::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px auto 4px 0; width: 1px; background: var(--sylph-coral, oklch(0.73 0.13 38)); } .ds-workspace-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-top: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sylph-live, oklch(0.78 0.12 174)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.78 0.12 174 / 14%); } .ds-workspace-copy { min-width: 0; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-copy strong { display: block; overflow: hidden; font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-workspace-copy small { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 2px; color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); font: 400 10px/1.5 'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-workspace-copy small span { margin-left: auto; } .ds-workspace:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 8%); } .ds-workspace:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.75 0.11 37); outline: none; }

components.name: Prompt Composer
components.description: Square-edged, lifted action surface anchored below the agent transcript.
components.html: ⌘ ↵
components.css: .ds-composer { width: min(100%, 768px); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 12%); border-radius: 0; background: #1c1a18; box-shadow: 0 16px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.24); color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: oklch(0.73 0.13 38 / 45%); } .ds-composer textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 80px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 13px/20px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; outline: none; resize: none; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); } .ds-composer-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 7%); color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); font: 400 10px/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-composer-bar span { margin-left: auto; } .ds-composer-bar button { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; } .ds-composer-bar button:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 5%); color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77); } .ds-composer-bar button:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.75 0.11 37); outline: none; } .ds-composer-bar .ds-composer-send { background: #ef9b7e; color: #241613; } .ds-composer-bar .ds-composer-send:hover { background: #f4af98; color: #241613; }

components.name: Browser Address
components.description: Dense editable URL field inside the persistent browser toolbar.
components.html: <label class="ds-browser-address"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c2.5 2.5 3.7 5.5 3.7 9S14.5 18.5 12 21c-2.5-2.5-3.7-5.5-3.7-9S9.5 5.5 12 3Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg><input value="http://127.0.0.1:3000" aria-label="Preview URL"></label>
components.css: .ds-browser-address { display: flex; min-width: 260px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 8%); border-radius: 5px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 20%); color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); } .ds-browser-address:focus-within { border-color: oklch(0.73 0.13 38 / 50%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.73 0.13 38 / 20%); } .ds-browser-address svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: none; } .ds-browser-address input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77 / 75%); font: 400 10px/1.5 'Geist Mono', monospace; outline: none; }

components.name: Live Status Chip
components.description: Labeled aqua status for a connected browser or remote Workspace.
components.css: .ds-live-chip { display: inline-flex; height: 20px; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 10%); border-radius: 5px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 4.5%); color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); font: 400 10px/1.4 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-live-chip > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sylph-live, oklch(0.78 0.12 174)); } .ds-live-chip:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.75 0.11 37); outline: none; }

components.name: Review Tabs
components.description: Line tabs that switch between Changes and Checks beneath the browser.
components.css: .ds-review-tabs { display: flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 8px; border-block: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.02 76 / 12%); background: #171614; } .ds-review-tabs button { position: relative; align-self: stretch; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); font: 500 12px/1.4 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-review-tabs button:hover { color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77); } .ds-review-tabs button:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.75 0.11 37); outline: none; } .ds-review-tabs .ds-review-active { color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77); } .ds-review-tabs .ds-review-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: currentColor; } .ds-review-tabs span { color: #4ade80; font: 400 9px/1.4 'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-review-tabs i { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-left: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sylph-live, oklch(0.78 0.12 174)); }

components.name: Check Row
components.description: Compact proof row pairing textual status with machine detail.
components.html: Typecheckpackages/uipassed
components.css: .ds-check-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 6%); background: oklch(0.145 0.008 52); color: oklch(0.93 0.014 77); } .ds-check-row svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: none; color: #4ade80; } .ds-check-row strong { font: 500 12px/1.4 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-check-row span { margin-left: auto; color: oklch(0.68 0.013 70); font: 400 10px/1.5 'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-check-row .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-check-row:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 2.5%); }

narrative.overview:
Sylph is a dense, dark engineering workspace in which agent intent, a running product, and proof remain visible together. Its visual world is calm and workmanlike: warm soft-black planes, warm near-white text, fine separators, compact controls, and a small number of precise state signals. The agent thread is the narrative center, while the persistent browser and review surface make verification part of the work rather than a destination after it.

The system is familiar enough for sustained IDE use without becoming a file-editor-first IDE or a generic dashboard. Repository hierarchy anchors orientation, the active Workspace is cut into that hierarchy with a coral hairline, and live browser state is reserved for aqua. Dense chrome gives way to more generous transcript measure so the interface feels deliberate rather than cramped.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, tonal dark planes separated by hairlines rather than card chrome
Compact sans-serif interface text with monospace reserved for machine output
Coral for selection and agent action; aqua only for live state
Persistent thread, browser, changes, and checks within one Workspace
Nearly square geometry with clipped 4–9px corners
Explicit mobile modes instead of a compressed desktop split

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral means selection or agent action; aqua means live or connected. Never exchange their roles.

rules.name: The Preview Boundary Rule
rules.body: Light surfaces may appear inside the browser viewport because they belong to the product under test. Sylph chrome remains dark around them.

rules.name: The Human-or-Machine Rule
rules.body: Conversation and navigation use Geist sans; values emitted by tools or runtimes use Geist Mono.

rules.name: The Quiet-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Structural bars use 10–13px type. Large product-style headings do not belong in Workspace chrome.

rules.name: The Stable-Orientation Rule
rules.body: Repository and nested Workspace identity remain on the left while the active work changes to their right.

rules.name: The Proof-Stays-Present Rule
rules.body: On desktop, browser proof remains beside the thread and review remains directly below it.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Use plane changes and separators for structure. Shadows are reserved for the composer and content inside the browser preview.

rules.name: The Clipped-Corner Rule
rules.body: Operational chrome lives between 4px and 9px. Rounded geometry must remain subordinate to the dense panel topology.

dos: Do preserve the Organization → Repository → nested Workspace hierarchy and keep it persistent on desktop.
Do make the browser persistent beside the thread and keep Changes and Checks directly beneath it.
Do use coral as a narrow selection/action cue and aqua as a labeled live-state cue.
Do keep app chrome compact, keyboard-visible, and structured by fine separators.
Do switch narrow screens to explicit Agent, Preview, and Review modes.
Do use monospace only for URLs, branches, timings, counts, diffs, and other machine output.
donts: Don't turn the Workspace into a file-editor-first IDE or a grid of equal-weight dashboard cards.
Don't split Repositories and Workspaces into separate navigation sections.
Don't use decorative gradients, glassmorphism, neon, or a physical cockpit metaphor.
Don't introduce oversized titles, floating card stacks, or pill-shaped chrome.
Don't hide browser proof behind a desktop tab or reduce it to a thumbnail.
Don't rely on color alone for connection, activity, success, or error state.
